title: Incoming-missile HUD icon and warning sound ignore destroyed / trail-cleanup missiles

edits.original: CC CC CC CC CC CC CC CC CC CC CC CC CC CC CC CC CC CC CC CC
edits.note: helper in INT3 padding: test byte [rax+648h],6; jnz -> cmp eax,eax (ZF=1, i.e. 'skip'); else cmp byte [rax+361h],0; ret. Reads only, preserves registers
HUD icon predicate: 'shr ecx,1; test cl,1' (state bit 1) becomes 'test cl,6' (bits 1 or 2). ecx is dead afterwards
warning-sound query 1: 'cmp [rax+361h],dil' (edi is zeroed at 0x3AF33A and never written in the loop) becomes call helper; the following je is unchanged
warning-sound query 2: 'cmp byte [rax+361h],0' becomes call helper; the following je is unchanged
